title: A log-majorization inequality for normal matrices with applications to determinantal inequalities and geometric means
summary: We establish a log-majorization inequality comparing the eigenvalues of the interlaced product $Y^t X^*Y^{1-t}X$ with those of $X^*YX$, valid for every positive semi-definite $Y$ and every normal $X$, with the inequality reversing for $t \notin[0,1]$ when $Y$ is positive definite. This extends known Hermitian results to the strictly larger class of normal matrices, where normality is shown to be the exact structural hypothesis, not a technical convenience.
